svg.title: Halo Collision Engine
svg.desc: Sixty-two moving formations travel at speed 29, beyond the usual maximum 12, and carry 74 concentric halos instead of the usual maximum 50. Their greatly expanded rings overlap into monochrome moire; short trail remnants preserve the violent motion history. Native toolbar flow: nested circle echoes → sheared cellular interference, with a luminance-preserving monochrome palette.
